title: Apple (AAPL) Downgraded to Sell at BidaskClub
text:
Tweet 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by stock analysts at BidaskClub from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report issued on Friday. 
Several other equities analysts have also weighed in on the stock. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 13th. Drexel Hamilton reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 24th. Piper Jaffray Companies reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective (up from $196.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 31st. Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $171.48 price objective on the stock. in a research report on Monday, October 30th. Finally, Nomura set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, November 27th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have issued a hold rating, thirty-six have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $200.70. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of Apple ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded up $0.40 on Friday, hitting $171.51. 39,068,242 shares of the stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 27,000,000. The company has a market capitalization of $880,590.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.66, a PEG ratio of 1.40 and a beta of 1.23. Apple has a 52 week low of $120.62 and a 52 week high of $180.10. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. The company had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $50.71 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The company’s revenue was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $1.50 earnings per share. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.2 EPS for the current year. 
In other news, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, November 22nd. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total value of $1,004,544.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 81,560 shares in the company, valued at approximately $14,224,064. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 over the last quarter. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Institutional investors and hedge funds have recently bought and sold shares of the company. Enterprise Financial Services Corp raised its holdings in Apple by 23.8% in the 4th quarter. Enterprise Financial Services Corp now owns 15,330 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,594,000 after buying an additional 2,948 shares during the last quarter. Schaper Benz & Wise Investment Counsel Inc. WI raised its holdings in Apple by 0.4% in the 4th quarter. Schaper Benz & Wise Investment Counsel Inc. WI now owns 76,786 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $12,994,000 after buying an additional 303 shares during the last quarter. Arthur M. Cohen & Associates LLC bought a new position in Apple in the 4th quarter valued at approximately $11,544,000. Advisor Partners LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 5.4% in the 4th quarter. Advisor Partners LLC now owns 121,055 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $21,603,000 after buying an additional 6,174 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Waldron LP raised its holdings in Apple by 21.4% in the 4th quarter. Waldron LP now owns 24,195 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,094,000 after buying an additional 4,269 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors own 60.20% of the company’s stock.
